demo.program:
# Elm — self-test quiz demo
qa = [
    ("Who created Elm?", "Evan Czaplicki"),
    ("What paradigm is Elm?", "functional"),
    ("What is creator?", "Evan Czaplicki"),
    ("What is first appeared?", "2012"),
    ("What is paradigm?", "functional"),
    ("What is typing?", "static"),
    ("What is file extension?", ".elm"),
    ("What is hello world?", "text \"Hello, world!\""),
]
score = 0
for i, (q, a) in enumerate(qa, 1):
    print(f"Q{i}: {q}")
    ans = input("Your answer: ").strip().lower()
    if ans and ans in a.lower():
        print("Correct.")
        score += 1
    else:
        print(f"Answer: {a}")
print(f"Score: {score}/{len(qa)}")
